info.description: Contract only: the public endpoint is disabled until authentication, authorization, target binding and operations are implemented. API tokens use tpapi_ and are distinct from MCP tokens. No arbitrary shell, WordPress database, uploads or wp-config.php deployment.

delete.summary: Queue the permanent deletion of one backup

400.description: Invalid syntax, JSON, cursor or idempotency key

403.description: Permission denied for a known owned target

404.description: Target, backup (error code backup_not_found) or operation not found or not accessible

422.description: Operation rejected for this target: backup_protected (newest backup of the site), backup_in_use (a backup is being created or its outcome is unclear), or capability_unavailable (not a WordPress site)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (error code rate_limited: per account, or per client IP before authentication, i.e. after 20 failed authentications or after 600 requests per minute from one IP), or the account already has four open jobs (error code queue_full; nothing was created, retry later). Retry-After gives the seconds to wait.

503.description: API or hosting backend unavailable; also error code api_draining during a maintenance window (new writes are not accepted, Retry-After 120, no job or idempotency entry is created)

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (api_draining only)

405.description: Method not allowed for this route

parameters.name: site_id
parameters.description: Opaque public site identifier; never a domain name

parameters.name: backup_id
parameters.description: Backup id from GET /sites/{site_id}/backups (the file name)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retained for 24 hours per account, token, method and route. Reuse after expiry may create a new operation.

delete.description: Irreversible. The backup is removed from the WordPress installation as an asynchronous operation (kind backups:delete). backup_id is the id returned by GET /sites/{site_id}/backups (path-encoding of + and : is optional). Two rules protect the site: the newest backup is never deleted (422 backup_protected), and no backup is deleted while a backup is being created or its outcome is unclear (422 backup_in_use). Both rules are checked when the request arrives and again when the operation runs; in the second case the operation ends as failed with the same error_code. An unknown id is 404 backup_not_found. A repeated request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation and never deletes twice. The result of a succeeded operation is {filename, remaining_backups, deletion_verified: true}; if the deletion could not be confirmed, the operation ends as unknown.

get.summary: List the operations created with this token, newest first
get.description: Returns only operations that this token created, for sites that are still among its targets and whose original permission the token (and its issuing user) still holds. Other tokens, other accounts and other sites never appear, and the page boundary depends on visible rows only. No hosting backend is contacted. Does not count as a poll of the individual operations.

get.description: Health and intake state for monitors and CI. No authentication, no account data, no audit entry; the per-IP request limit applies. While the API is switched off this route answers 503 api_unavailable like every other route.

200.description: API is reachable; status is draining while the API accepts no new changes (reads and polling continue)

405.description: Method not allowed for this route

429.description: Per client IP limit (rate_limited): this route needs no token but counts toward the IP request limit. Retry-After gives the seconds to wait.

503.description: API switched off (api_unavailable) or hosting unavailable

details.description: Only in GET /sites/{site_id}, never in the list GET /sites

result.description: Result of a succeeded operation. backups:delete: {filename, remaining_backups, deletion_verified}.

SiteDetails.description: Read-only extras taken from the hosting inventory that is already read for the request. Only values available without extra backend calls are offered.

wordpress_version.description: Installed WordPress version; null if unknown and always null for AI Launch sites

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute for the account (currently 60). Sent on every answer after authentication.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current one-minute window of the account; 0 once the limit is reached.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix time (seconds) at which the current one-minute window ends and the count starts again.
